name: sc2-mcp
description: MCP server for StarCraft2.ai: ask StarCraft II questions, upload replays, run the AI Coach and ask follow-up questions from any MCP client.

scripts.build:
tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --legal-comments=none
